def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):

    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()

    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import cv2
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
S=4
W,H=256*S,144*S
original=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
base=cv2.resize(original,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)
y,x=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(float); x/=S;y/=S

# Remove only the initial exposed falling thread; all objects remain photographic.
mask=np.zeros((144,256),np.uint8)
for yy in range(17,52):
    xx=126.5+(yy-17)*.139
    cv2.line(mask,(round(xx-1),yy),(round(xx+1),yy),255,1)
clean=cv2.inpaint(original,mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
clean=cv2.resize(clean,(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(np.float32)
# The outline protects the complete stationary toy, including its eyes and beak.
def path_points(nodes):
    pts=[]
    for p0,p1,p2,p3 in nodes:
        for a in np.linspace(0,1,24):
            pts.append(tuple((1-a)**3*np.array(p0)+3*(1-a)**2*a*np.array(p1)+3*(1-a)*a*a*np.array(p2)+a**3*np.array(p3)))
    return pts
outline=path_points([
((123,51),(117,50),(110,54),(108,63)),
((108,63),(107,67),(107,71),(109,74)),
((109,74),(105,75),(104.5,79),(110,81)),
((110,81),(106,83),(105,90),(107,95)),
((107,95),(108,103),(124,106),(138,101)),
((138,101),(149,98),(156,91),(152,79)),
((152,79),(151,73),(146,66),(139,65)),
((139,65),(137,57),(133,51),(123,51))])
def polygon_mask(points):
    im=Image.new('L',(W,H));d=ImageDraw.Draw(im);d.polygon([(int(a*S),int(b*S)) for a,b in points],fill=255)
    return np.array(im).astype(float)/255
# Refine the lower silhouette against the actual yellow pixels.
duck=polygon_mask(outline)
photo_yellow=(base[:,:,0]>115)&(base[:,:,1]>105)&(base[:,:,2]<base[:,:,0]*.66)
core=cv2.dilate(photo_yellow.astype(np.uint8),np.ones((3,3),np.uint8)).astype(float)
# No pool reaches the head, so only the low edge requires a color-based refinement.
duck=np.where(y>96,duck*core,duck)
duck=gaussian_filter(duck,.55)
tray=polygon_mask([(7,111),(74,74),(82,72),(191,86),(207,95),(211,108),(205,144),(87,139)])


def curve_mask(points,width):
    layer=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
    pts=np.array(points)*S
    cv2.polylines(layer,[np.round(pts).astype(np.int32)],False,255,max(1,round(width*S)),cv2.LINE_AA)
    for p in (pts[0],pts[-1]):cv2.circle(layer,tuple(np.round(p).astype(int)),max(1,round(width*S/2)),255,-1,cv2.LINE_AA)
    return layer.astype(float)/255

def apply(im,alpha,color):
    a=np.clip(alpha,0,1)[...,None]
    col=np.asarray(color)
    return im*(1-a)+col*a

def render(t):
    im=clean.copy()
    # A shallow, spreading liquid layer in the tray's perspective plane.
    growth=t**.64
    cx=136-.85*t;cy=102+1.50*t
    rx=7+19*growth;ry=2.4+5.9*growth
    dx=(x-cx)/rx;dy=(y-cy)/ry
    theta=np.arctan2(dy,dx)
    wav=.027*np.sin(5*theta+1.1)+.014*np.sin(9*theta-.6)+.009*np.sin(13*theta+.2)
    dist=np.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)/(1+wav)
    dist2=np.sqrt(((x-(147-.3*t))/(4+10*growth))**2+((y-(98+1.2*t))/(1.9+3.15*growth))**2)
    # Two adjoining lobes flow around the base rather than appearing as isolated droplets.
    near=np.minimum(dist,dist2)
    edge=np.clip((1-near)*min(rx,ry)*S+.5,0,1)
    pool=edge*tray*(1-duck)
    thickness=np.clip((1-near)*4,0,1)
    reflect=.5+.5*np.sin(x*.032+y*.026)
    red=np.empty_like(im)
    red[:,:,0]=97+30*thickness+9*reflect
    red[:,:,1]=17+9*reflect
    red[:,:,2]=16+8*reflect
    # Preserve diffuse scene reflections through the transparent red fluid.
    red += im*np.array([.30,.14,.14])[None,None,:]
    im=apply(im,pool*(.63+.19*thickness),red)
    # Soft curved meniscus, and reflected window light grazing the surface.
    rim=np.exp(-((near-.979)*min(rx,ry)/.31)**2)*pool

    sheen=np.exp(-((y-(cy+6+.025*(x-cx))) /1.8)**2)*np.exp(-((x-(cx-10))/27)**2)
    im+=pool[...,None]*sheen[...,None]*np.array([17.,10.,10.])

    rr=np.sqrt((x-148)**2+((y-101)/.38)**2)
    phase=rr*.71-t*8

    # Flow divides over the curved crown and runs over the shoulder.
    onset=1-np.exp(-t*2.8)
    # Broad but thin wetted shoulder area follows the slope of the rubber.
    shoulder=np.exp(-(((x-145.6)/3.3)**2+((y-78.5)/9)**2))
    headwet=np.exp(-(((x-135.2)/2.0)**2+((y-61)/5.6)**2))

    im=apply(im,film,np.array([238.,67.,18.]))
    # The two small flowing rivulets remain translucent, not a recoloring of the toy.
    paths=[([(131.5,53.8),(133.5,56),(135.7,59),(137.1,62.5),(138.8,68),(143.3,72.8),(147.8,79),(150.3,85),(149.6,91),(145.4,98.5)],1.35,.74),
           ([(131.6,54.0),(131.8,59),(132.5,65),(131.4,70),(132.7,76),(136.5,81),(138.1,87),(137,93),(134.8,100.9)],.75,.45)]
    for k,(nodes,width,op) in enumerate(paths):
        # The advance of the leading edge is rapid under gravity.
        length=(1-np.exp(-t*(4.2 if k==0 else 2.0)))*(len(nodes)-1)
        n=int(length);partial=nodes[:n+1]
        if n<len(nodes)-1:
            p=np.array(nodes[n])*(1-(length-n))+np.array(nodes[n+1])*(length-n)
            partial=partial+[tuple(p)]
        if len(partial)>1:
            # Slight traveling thickness fluctuations in the water sheet.
            flow=curve_mask(partial,width)
            flow=gaussian_filter(flow,.65)*duck
            pulse=.9+.1*np.sin(y*.7-t*13+k)
            im=apply(im,flow*op*onset*pulse,[235,49,21])
            glint=curve_mask([(a-.30,b) for a,b in partial],.20)*duck
            glint*=.16*onset*(.2+.8*np.maximum(0,np.sin(y*.57-t*7+k))**6)
            im=apply(im,glint,[255,219,162])
    cap=np.exp(-(((x-131.8)/2.7)**2+((y-54.2)/.85)**2))*duck*onset
    im=apply(im,cap*.66,[242,70,31])
    # Runoff reconnects to the shallow puddle at the lower right edge.
    if t>.25:
        runoff=curve_mask([(147.1,97.5),(146.6,99.3),(146.6+.23*np.sin(t*9),101.2)],.8)
        im=apply(im,runoff*.70*onset,[206,50,33])
        contact=np.exp(-(((x-146.9)/2.3)**2+((y-101.4)/.64)**2))*pool
        im=apply(im,contact*.5,[206,67,49])

    ys=np.linspace(16.2,53.9,160)
    xs=126.5+.140*(ys-17)
    xs+=.19*np.sin(ys*.47-t*10)*np.sin(np.pi*(ys-16.2)/37.7)
    points=list(zip(xs,ys))
    stream=curve_mask(points,1.65)

    streaminner=curve_mask([(a-.22,b) for a,b in points],.48)
    bright=.45+.24*np.sin(y*.51-t*14)
    im=apply(im,streaminner*bright,[255,147,111])
    streamedge=curve_mask([(a+.61,b) for a,b in points],.24)
    im=apply(im,streamedge*.38,[187,57,42])
    # A few subpixel impact droplets; short ballistic arcs return to the crown.
    for k in range(3):
        age=(t+k*.19)%.64
        if age<.28:
            vx=[-7.,8.,3.][k]; vy=[-16.,-13.,-19.][k]
            px=132+vx*age;py=54+vy*age+48*age*age

    return cv2.resize(im,(256,144),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)

frames=np.stack(frames).astype(np.uint8)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
